outcome: Plasma levels of catecholamines (norepinephrine and epinephrine)
Plasma levels of cytokines (TNF-α, IL-6, IL-8, IL-4, IL-10)
cohort: 30 healthy pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean sections
finding: General anesthesia resulted in a more consistent increase in inflammatory response and catecholamine levels compared to spinal anesthesia.
